verdict.rationale: Training on user data is a fair privacy question for a hosted document-parsing SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack has no no-training policy, opt-out setting, or contractual training exclusion. Self-hosting/BYOC ('keeping your data... under your control'), SOC 2, and the HIPAA BAA are adjacent privacy and deployment controls; none of them documents that customer data is excluded from model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
